title: A fish with a transparent head
description: Look closely at the green shapes inside the dome: those are its eyes. MBARI's footage makes the deep sea feel like another planet.

title: The giant phantom jelly
description: A rarely seen jelly drifts through the deep with long, ribbon-like arms. Follow MBARI's camera into a world that looks almost unreal.

title: A black hole, translated into sound
description: Astronomical data becomes an eerie listening experience. This is a sonification of pressure waves in the Perseus cluster, shifted into human hearing range—not a microphone recording in space.

title: The clockwork friar
description: Watch a mechanical figure walk and gesture in the Smithsonian's demonstration. A small, uncanny encounter with the history of moving machines.
